body.text: Interface proposal: task_store exposes add_task(path, title), list_tasks(path, include_done=False), complete_task(path, task_id), accepting str/pathlike paths. Return fresh dicts with exactly id:int, title:str, done:bool; lists sorted by id, default open. Store JSON object {"next_id": positive integer, "tasks": array}; validate entire database strictly (exact keys, unique positive non-bool IDs, trimmed nonblank titles, boolean done, next_id greater than all IDs). Missing DB reads empty; add creates parents. Atomic same-directory tempfile plus os.replace. Domain/input/corrupt DB errors raise ValueError with useful message; missing ID also ValueError; IO raises OSError. CLI catches ValueError/OSError and argparse handles malformed IDs with no traceback. complete_task requires positive integer, rejects bool. No concurrency. Do you agree, and what test coverage/acceptance guard do you propose? We must freeze both contracts before edits.
